fomod.Name: War Banners
fomod.Author: synthalorian
fomod.Description: Craft three war banners at a tanning rack or a forge and plant them with a lesser power: you and nearby followers rally around them for a short time. Each banner has one buff (armor, stamina regeneration, or weapon damage). Vanilla banner meshes, no world edits. Base game only, no SKSE. Early beta.
